text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Logo! Have you seen my 
celebration sign yet?!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I saw! There were "Congrats on the 
logo!" signs all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Even when I looked away, there was another 
one right in front of me... I really 
couldn't help feeling embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: ...Still, why did you put out so many?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Even just one makes a tremendous impact. A 
vividly painted background with dynamic, 
brush-style lettering... It must have 
taken a lot of work.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because I wanted to! All I have to do is 
what I want to do. If I do that, I'll 
definitely get the result I want!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, the bond connecting us has grown 
even stronger! Right? That's proof right 
there!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
I... see? Still, though, why give a sign 
to the daughter of a signboard maker? It 
was quite unexpected, so I was surprised.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course I picked it from among things 
that you love!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I considered antiques too, but nothing 
really clicked. So I figured it'd be best 
to make something myself.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Making you the face of it was my choice, 
too. So I knew it wasn't a mistake. 
—You're happy right now, aren't ya? Huh!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, naturally. ...In that case, please 
give me all of those signboards later.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
So your message will never fade... Even 
once it becomes an antique, I'll cherish 
it forever and ever.
